nodes.label: مراجعة الأرقام بعد أول ١٠ حجوزات (Review After First 10 Bookings)
nodes.norm_label: مراجعة الارقام بعد اول ١٠ حجوزات (review after first 10 bookings)

nodes.label: خمسة أخطاء في التسعير السابق (Five Prior Pricing Corrections)
nodes.norm_label: خمسة اخطاء في التسعير السابق (five prior pricing corrections)
nodes.rationale: Corrects overestimated gas cost, underpriced Jubail surcharge, weak standalone heater rental margin, a small-package price too far below the family package, and previously uncounted depreciation.

nodes.label: عزل الإهلاك (Depreciation Isolation, 35 SAR/booking)
nodes.rationale: Ignoring depreciation means eating into capital and calling it profit; isolating it funds full equipment replacement after 120 bookings.

nodes.label: عرض الإطلاق (Launch Offer — 20% for first 10, swap not discount)
nodes.norm_label: عرض الاطلاق (launch offer — 20% for first 10, swap not discount)
nodes.rationale: Framed as a trade for reviews/photos rather than a discount, to avoid teaching customers to wait for sales.

nodes.label: حساب الإهلاك (Depreciation Fund, 35 SAR/booking)
nodes.rationale: Separate untouched wallet; after 120 bookings, full replacement cost of equipment is saved.

nodes.label: عرض التأسيس (Launch Offer — 20% for first 10 bookings)
nodes.norm_label: عرض التاسيس (launch offer — 20% for first 10 bookings)
nodes.rationale: Framed as an exchange (for reviews/photos), not a price cut — published price stays 690.

nodes.label: قاعدة بيانات العملاء (Customer Database / Occasion Field)
nodes.norm_label: قاعدة بيانات العملاء (customer database / occasion field)
nodes.rationale: The 'occasion' field is called the most valuable field because it determines exactly when to re-message a year later.

nodes.label: تقويم التذكير الموسمي (Seasonal Reminder Calendar)
nodes.rationale: Because the service is occasional, not habitual, the business itself must be the reminder rather than waiting to be remembered.

nodes.label: انشر ٩ منشورات دفعة واحدة (Nine Launch Posts)
nodes.norm_label: انشر ٩ منشورات دفعة واحدة (nine launch posts)
nodes.rationale: An account with only 3 photos looks unserious and generates no bookings; must launch with a full content grid.

nodes.label: انشر الأسعار علناً (Publish Prices Publicly)
nodes.rationale: Identified as the single biggest weakness across every competitor.

nodes.label: شراكات توزيع بتكلفة صفر (Zero-Cost Distribution Partnerships)
nodes.norm_label: شراكات توزيع بتكلفة صفر (zero-cost distribution partnerships)

nodes.label: بروفة تركيب مقيسة بالثانية (Under 45 min)
nodes.rationale: The under-45-minute promise is publicly advertised on the site, so it must be verified by rehearsal before being sold.

nodes.label: سقف تكلفة الاكتساب (CAC Ceiling via LTV, 505 SAR)
nodes.norm_label: سقف تكلفة الاكتساب (cac ceiling via ltv, 505 sar)
nodes.rationale: LTV of 2,019 SAR (accounting for repeat bookings and referral effect) divided by a healthy 4:1 ratio sets a maximum acceptable acquisition cost.

nodes.label: روتين حصاد المحتوى (Six-Shot Content Harvesting Routine)
nodes.norm_label: روتين حصاد المحتوى (six-shot content harvesting routine)
nodes.rationale: Same six shots at every booking regardless of fatigue — 24 content pieces/month builds an archive competitors cannot replicate with money.

nodes.label: نموذج السنة الأولى المالي (Year One Financial Model)
nodes.norm_label: نموذج السنة الاولى المالي (year one financial model)
nodes.rationale: Conservative model projecting 128 bookings / 88,320 SAR revenue / ~68,992 SAR net after depreciation in year one, accounting for Eastern Province seasonality (dead summer for beach sessions).

nodes.label: خمسة أشياء تهدم المحرك (Five Engine-Killing Mistakes)
nodes.norm_label: خمسة اشياء تهدم المحرك (five engine-killing mistakes)
nodes.rationale: Warns against buying followers, over-expanding geographically before saturating density, inconsistent posting, accepting bookings that can't be executed well, and skipping the content routine.

nodes.label: دولاب النمو (Growth Flywheel, K=1.11)
nodes.rationale: Each booking reaches ~10 guests, produces content, drives ~470 local views, generates 1.9 inquiries, converting at a viral coefficient K=1.11 (>1 means self-sustaining growth) via combined content path (0.66) and direct referral path (0.45); but K only compounds once the flywheel already has bookings — the first 10 must be pushed manually.

nodes.label: إرسال الصور مجاناً بعد التأمين (Free Edited Photo Delivery)
nodes.norm_label: ارسال الصور مجانا بعد التامين (free edited photo delivery)
nodes.rationale: Called the single strongest move in the playbook: 20 minutes of editing produces organic word-of-mouth spread inside a cherished family memory rather than an ad, and no competitor does it.

nodes.label: الإحالة المزدوجة (Double Referral Program, 100/100 SAR)
nodes.rationale: Rewarding both referrer and referee removes the awkwardness of 'selling' to a friend; at 100/100 SAR LTV:CAC is 10.1:1, far above the 3:1 healthy benchmark, so the program can afford to be generous.

nodes.label: التكلفة الاقتصادية للحجز (Real Cost per Booking, 117 SAR)
nodes.norm_label: التكلفة الاقتصادية للحجز (real cost per booking, 117 sar)
nodes.rationale: 82 SAR cash cost + 35 SAR equipment depreciation; the economic (not just cash) cost is the correct basis for pricing decisions.

nodes.label: تكلفة الوقت (Time Cost, 4.1 hrs/booking)
nodes.rationale: Time must be priced as real wage (164 SAR at 40 SAR/hr), distinguishing a business owner from an employee of oneself.

nodes.label: حساب بنكي منفصل للمشروع
nodes.rationale: Without separating project and personal funds, the owner can never truly know if the business is profitable — cited as the most common reason small business owners misjudge their numbers.

nodes.label: نظام النقل في الونيت (Load Order System)
nodes.norm_label: نظام النقل في الونيت (load order system)
nodes.rationale: Last item loaded is first item installed — saves 10 minutes per booking.

nodes.label: ضريبة القيمة المضافة (VAT) — Not Needed Yet
nodes.norm_label: ضريبة القيمة المضافة (vat) — not needed yet
nodes.rationale: Registration mandatory above 375,000 SAR revenue, optional above 187,500; projected revenue (~88,000) is well below both thresholds, so skip for now.

nodes.label: سُهَيْل (Brand Identity)
nodes.rationale: Positioned as authentic Najdi heritage (sadu weave, camel-cream fabric) vs. the generic white-tent/candle competitors in the Eastern Province.

nodes.label: تأمين مسترد (Refundable Deposit, 100 SAR)
nodes.rationale: Lowered vs. market norm because the liquid-resistant fabric reduces damage risk — trust in the material, not in the customer's wallet.

nodes.label: توثيق النشاط (Business Verification)
nodes.rationale: Verification badge via the Saudi Business Center platform measurably raises customer trust — cited as the reason customers prepay a stalled competitor.

nodes.label: بند الخصوصية (Privacy Statement)
nodes.rationale: Preempts the target segment's top objection before they voice it.

nodes.label: فيديو قبل وبعد (Before/After Video)
nodes.rationale: Described as the strongest content format in this niche.

nodes.label: فيديو اختبار السوائل (Liquid Test Video)
nodes.rationale: Considered the most important content piece in the account — visual proof that isn't debatable.

nodes.label: وثيقة العمل الحر (Freelance Document)
nodes.rationale: Categories listed (specialized services, guided transport, rural development, home crafts, accounting, food carts, delivery) do not clearly include rental/event activities per two independent unofficial sources; must be verified directly with the platform or the Saudi Business Center before relying on it.

nodes.label: السجل التجاري (Commercial Registration)
nodes.rationale: Fallback if freelance document doesn't cover the activity; costs 200 SAR/year, issued online via Nafath, needs only a national address, framed as a step not an obstacle.
